security-protection.label: Website protection
security-protection.description: A request firewall (path traversal, SQL injection, script injection, PHP wrappers, code execution, PHP uploads, scanner tools), login protection that locks out an address after repeated failed logins, IP blocks, XML-RPC and user-enumeration blocking, and 404-flood blocking. From activation the firewall logs, repeated failed logins lock an address out and user enumeration is refused; firewall blocking, XML-RPC blocking and 404-flood blocking are turned on by the owner or GoBuildWP Cloud. Cloud can also push a request-rule pack and a fleet-wide reputation blocklist, and install a pre-WordPress firewall (auto_prepend_file) that keeps blocks working while WordPress is broken. Administrators who are signed in are never blocked. Events record the address, rule and path, never the request's values.
